subtitle: Hide and tidy menu bar icons
promotionalText: On macOS 27? This App Store version cannot hide icons there, due to the App Store sandbox. Get the free macOS 27 build at dwarves.foundation/opensource.
description:
Hidden Bar hides the menu bar icons you do not need, so your Mac's menu bar stays clean. Click the arrow to show them, click it again to tuck them away.

Hide menu bar clutter
- Command-drag icons to the left of the separator to hide them when the bar collapses.
- Click the arrow, or press your own keyboard shortcut, to show or hide them.
- Hide icons again automatically after 5 seconds to 1 minute, or never.

Three sections, one tidy bar
- Shown: the icons you always want to see.
- Hidden: icons that appear when you expand the bar.
- Always hidden: icons that stay out of sight even when the bar expands. Option-click the arrow to reach them.

More ways to show hidden icons
- Rest the pointer on the menu bar, scroll down on it, or shake the pointer at the top of the screen. Each one is optional and off by default.
- Shift-click the arrow to use the full width of the menu bar for one expansion.

Settings that stay simple
- Tabs for General, Appearance, Advanced and About.
- A status card that says whether Hidden Bar is working, and what to do if it is not.
- Open Hidden Bar at login.

Pick the arrow you like
- Arrow, chevron, dot or line.
- An optional faded arrow while icons are hidden.

Free and open source
Hidden Bar is free, with no ads and no account, and it collects no data. The source code is public at github.com/consolelabs/hidden. Available in English, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Croatian, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Polish, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese.

About macOS 27
This App Store version cannot hide icons on macOS 27, because the App Store sandbox does not allow the method macOS 27 needs. The app shows a one-time notice when this applies. The macOS 27 compatible build is a free direct download from dwarves.foundation/opensource. On macOS 13 to macOS 26, this version works as described above.

Requires macOS 13 or later.

Questions or feature ideas: support@console.so, or open an issue on GitHub.
whatsNew:
New in 1.13.0:
- Redesigned Settings: tabs for General, Appearance, Advanced and About, plus a status card that says whether Hidden Bar is working and what to do if it is not.
- More ways to show hidden icons, all off by default: scroll down on the menu bar, or shake the pointer at the top of the screen. Hover to expand now sits in the same group.
- Shift-click the arrow to use the full menu bar for one expansion.
- The always-hidden section stays hidden when the bar expands. Option-click the arrow to show it until the next collapse, and "Show Everything" in the right-click menu brings back icons lost there.
- "Hide icons again" is now one menu, with a Never choice.
- One shortcut recorder for every shortcut: it refuses a bare letter, and cancelling keeps your old shortcut.
- The app icon follows the macOS icon size and shadow, so it no longer looks oversized in the Dock.
- About shows which version you run and links the changelog.

macOS 27: this App Store version still cannot hide icons there (an App Store sandbox limit). The in-app notice now also shows the Homebrew command, and the macOS 27 compatible build is free at dwarves.foundation/opensource.
